reviews.body:
Parsing IPv6 networks before the host/port split is the right fix for #37153: `fc00::/7` was being cut at the first colon, and `[fc00::]/7` died on the suffix after the bracket. Gating this on `SubdomainWildcards::Enabled` keeps query targets from accepting a network, which the new tests pin.

The rejected cases (`/129`, a port after the prefix, `[fc00::/7]`) look right. One asymmetry to be aware of: unbracketed `fc00::/7` now works, but an individual address still needs brackets (`fc00::1` is in the error list, same as the existing `::` / `::80` cases in `test_net_descriptor_parse_for_list`). That is consistent with current address parsing; I would just mention it so nobody assumes the new path also relaxed bare addresses.
